items.title: Salesforce Solution Architect
items.content_html:
At Polestar, you will have the opportunity to influence the future architecture of one of our most strategic commercial platforms, working at the intersection of customer experience, business transformation, and modern digital engineering.

The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Digital Commercial plays a critical role in enabling customer growth, customer experience, sales, fleet and retailer operations, digital channels, and commercial excellence across all markets.

Salesforce is a strategic platform within Polestar's digital landscape, supporting customer engagement, sales, fleet operations, customer service, marketing, portals, AI-enabled experiences, and critical integrations with enterprise platforms such as ERP, integration platforms, data platforms, and other digital products.

As our business continues to evolve, we are strengthening our internal architecture capability and establishing clearer architectural ownership, standards, and governance across the Salesforce ecosystem. This role will help define the future direction of the platform, ensuring solutions remain scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with Polestar's enterprise architecture.

This position is located at Gothenburg, Sweden. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and onsite work, knowing that both in-person collaboration and individual time to focus are needed. What matters most is that people get the time, and support, to do what needs to be done. And to enjoy doing it, of course.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Salesforce Solution Architect, you will provide architectural leadership across Polestar's Salesforce landscape, spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce, customer portals, fleet solutions, and related integrations. You will work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, engineers, enterprise architects, and external partners to ensure that solutions are aligned with both business objectives and long-term technology strategy.

The role requires balancing customer experience, business process efficiency, integration complexity, security requirements, and platform sustainability. You will help teams make the right architectural decisions while reducing technical debt, increasing reuse, and enabling faster delivery across multiple products and markets. You will be a key contributor in defining platform guardrails, integration patterns, data ownership principles, and future-state architecture for one of Polestar's most business-critical platforms.

What you'll do

You will lead solution architecture across multiple initiatives and help shape the evolution of Polestar's Salesforce ecosystem.

See below for a more thorough breakdown of the various tasks and areas you'll be responsible for:

  • Designing scalable Salesforce solutions across customer, sales, service, fleet, and commercial domains

  • Leading solution architecture for strategic Salesforce initiatives and programmes

  • Defining architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for Salesforce development

  • Ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and technology standards

  • Driving integration architecture across Salesforce, AWS, ERP systems, customer identity, data platforms, and digital products

  • Defining data ownership, master data, and information flow principles

  • Supporting product teams in architecture decisions, technical design, and solution governance

  • Ensuring solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements

  • Managing cross-team dependencies and reducing solution complexity

  • Driving platform scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence

  • Supporting roadmap planning and target architecture definition

  • Contributing to architecture reviews and governance forums

  • Mentoring engineers and supporting the broader architecture community

In your daily work, you will collaborate with teams across CRM, Customer Experience, Sales, Fleet, Marketing, Customer Care, Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Commercial leadership. You will also work closely with enterprise architects, chief architects, solution architects, product teams, and strategic partners.

Who you are

You are comfortable navigating complex business domains and translating business needs into practical and sustainable Salesforce solutions. You can balance strategic thinking with hands-on architecture work and enjoy collaborating across business and technology teams. You have strong communication skills and can explain architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You understand that great architecture is not just about technology. It is about enabling business outcomes while maintaining simplicity, governance, and long-term sustainability.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Solution Architect, Salesforce Architect, or Lead Salesforce Consultant

  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities and architecture patterns

  • Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce integrations

  • Experience designing APIs, event-driven integrations, and distributed solutions

  • Strong understanding of customer data management and enterprise integration patterns

  • Experience working with cloud-native architectures and modern development practices

  • Knowledge of security, privacy, identity, and compliance requirements

  • Experience working in agile product organisations

  • Ability to lead architecture across multiple teams and business domains

The following would be considered an advantage:

  • Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect (CTA)

  • Experience with Marketing Cloud or Agentforce

  • Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, customer identity, and enterprise data platforms

  • Experience within automotive, retail, mobility, or direct-to-consumer digital businesses

Polestar is an international company, with various backgrounds represented. English, therefore, is the language of written and spoken communication. And though we have a global presence, we maintain the growth-mindset. Change happens often at Polestar. But so does progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment.

Is this you?

If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. Our selection process is ongoing, and the job advert will remain open until it's filled.

The Polestar journey is an electric one.

items.title: User Insights Leader
items.content_html:
The opportunity

We're currently looking for a User Insights Leader. Someone to join our Concepts & Simulation team, which is a part of the Attributes & Validation team in shaping and advancing the next generation of the Polestar user experience. Someone with a passion for understanding customer needs, translating insights into impactful experiences, and driving innovation at the intersection of technology, design, and human behaviour.

Polestar user experience development is entering a new phase focused on technology, functionality, and user satisfaction. We're investing in the next generation of the Polestar interface through streamlined everyday user journeys, deeper integration of AI-enabled experiences, and the technical foundations needed to support innovative and intuitive solutions.

Working at the center of UX, you'll combine user research, behavioural insights, customer data, and cross-functional collaboration to influence product direction and create experiences that are both desirable and easy to use. You'll play a key role in balancing customer needs, business objectives, and technical possibilities while helping shape the future of mobility.

This position is located at the Polestar headquarters in Gothenburg. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and onsite work, knowing that both in-person collaboration and individual time to focus are needed. What matters most is that people get the time, and support, to do what needs to be done. And to enjoy doing it, of course.

The responsibilities

In this role, you'll be expected to drive and structure complex Product User Experience initiatives while ensuring alignment across multiple functions and stakeholders. Working as a member of the Concepts & Simulation team, you'll be instrumental in defining user journeys, establishing interaction principles, and supporting the development of intuitive and seamless customer experiences.

See below for a more thorough breakdown of the various tasks and areas you'll be responsible for:

  • Lead and structure complex Product User Experience initiatives, defining user journeys, interaction principles, and use cases that create intuitive and seamless customer experiences.

  • Act as a cross-functional project lead, collaborating with Product, Design, Engineering, Customer Experience, Procurement, and external partners to drive alignment and delivery.

  • Define and maintain UX requirements at system, hardware, and software levels while co-creating UX solutions across product development teams.

  • Establish and manage UX evaluation methodologies, including usability assessments, customer satisfaction measurements, benchmarking, and comparative scoreboards.

  • Drive data-informed UX development by coordinating user research activities, leveraging customer insights, and identifying opportunities to improve product experiences.


The ideal candidate

In order to succeed in this role, and at Polestar in general, there are a few characteristics you'll need to have. Tenacity. Flexibility. Curiosity. The ability to take the initiative, to meet deadlines and requirements, and to abandon ideas when they're not feasible.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and who thrives when working across functions to solve complex customer experience challenges.

In addition, you'll need the following qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, User Experience or equivalent

  • Proven experience leading complex cross-functional projects within product development, balancing both strategic and operational responsibilities.

  • Strong expertise in UX principles, user journey mapping, interaction design methodologies, and customer-centric product development.

  • Experience developing evaluation frameworks, benchmarking methodologies, and translating customer insights into actionable product improvements.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, with the ability to influence decisions across a broad range of stakeholders.

  • Ability to influence and align stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.

Stakeholder interfaces

In this role, you'll collaborate with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders, including:

Internal

  • Product Management

  • Design

  • Customer Experience

  • R&D

  • Procurement

  • Attribute Leaders

  • Cross-functional Product Development Teams

External

  • Volvo Cars and stakeholders within the Geely Group

  • Suppliers and development partners

  • User research and customer insight partners

Polestar is an international company, with various backgrounds represented. English, therefore, is the language of written and spoken communication. And though we have a global presence, we maintain the growth mindset. Change happens often at Polestar. But so does progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment.

The process

If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. Our selection process is ongoing, and the job advert will remain open until it's filled.

The Polestar journey is an electric one

items.title: Compensation & Benefits Specialist
items.content_html:
The opportunity

We're currently looking for a Compensation & Benefits Specialist for a 14-month fixed-term contract, covering parental leave. If you're driven by making a real impact, take pride in providing high-quality support, and thrive on creating value for the business, this could be your next step. You’ll be part of a small, agile team and report to the Global Head of Compensation & Benefits. The team plays an important role in shaping fair, competitive, and compliant reward practices across Polestar. From merit review and bonus processes to pay transparency and pay equity, job architecture, job evaluation, incentive programs, international assignments, and benefits governance, the team partners closely with HR and both internal and external stakeholders.

This position is located at our Global Headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. We embrace a hybrid working model, recognizing the value of both in-person collaboration and focused remote work. What matters most is having the time, tools, trust, and support to get things done, and to enjoy doing them.

The responsibilities

In this role, you'll be a part of driving important Compensation & Benefits initiatives, including Pay Transparency, Pay Equity, Job Architecture, and the global Merit Review process. You'll be a trusted partner to HR and business leaders on all Compensation & Benefits matters, helping us design and deliver practices that support the attraction, retention, and motivation of talent across markets. You'll work on both Sweden-specific topics and global projects, combining strategic initiatives with hands-on operational delivery. See below for a more thorough breakdown of the various tasks and areas you'll be responsible for:

  • Lead initiatives related to Pay Transparency and Pay Equity.

  • Be a part of developing and maintaining our Job Architecture, including position evaluations, market benchmarking, salary range development, and role calibration.

  • Provide subject matter expertise and guidance in Compensation & Benefits, including communication and training for managers and employees.

  • Drive and contribute to local and global C&B projects, including share-based incentive programs, international assignments, policy updates, vendor relationships, and regulatory compliance.

  • Support Global Mobility processes, including international local hires and expat assignments, work permits, tax-related coordination, payroll input, and collaboration with external vendors.

  • Develop and maintain compensation structures and benchmarks to ensure competitive, fair, and business-relevant reward practices across markets.

  • Perform gender pay gap and pay equity analysis, identifying trends, risks, and actions to support transparent and compliant compensation practices.

  • Participate in merit review activities, including planning, data preparation, stakeholder support, process coordination, and follow-up to ensure a fair and well-executed annual review.

The ideal candidate

In order to succeed in this role, and at Polestar in general, you'll need to be proactive, adaptable, and detail-oriented. You take ownership, meet deadlines, and are not afraid to pivot when needed. You are equally comfortable contributing to strategic initiatives and handling hands-on operational tasks.

You have a structured and analytical way of working, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and practical solutions. Since this role involves close collaboration with HR, managers, employees, unions, external vendors, and authorities, strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and professional way will be important. You can work independently with sensitive information, while also thriving in a team setting and in an international environment where priorities can shift and collaboration across countries and cultures is part of everyday work.

In addition, you'll need the following qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

  • At least three years of experience within Compensation & Benefits, preferably in a specialist role.

  • Strong knowledge of compensation frameworks, benefits programs, job evaluation methodologies, market benchmarking, and reward processes.

  • Experience working with HRIS systems, preferably Workday, compensation analytics tools, and advanced Excel.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication skills, with discretion when handling confidential information and experience working across multiple countries and cultures.

Polestar is an international company, with various backgrounds represented. English, therefore, is the language of written and spoken communication. And though we have a global presence, we maintain the growth-mindset. Change happens often at Polestar. But so does progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment.

The process

If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. Our selection process is ongoing, and the job advert will remain open until it’s filled.

The Polestar journey is an electric one.
